source_sha_requirement: Rebuild and rerun audit whenever any raw question file changes.
limitations: Mathematical correctness of the checked answer and expected factorization is distinct from what an MCQ proves about the student's independent problem-solving process.
Sixteen complete-factorization outcomes are composite evidence; their separate intermediate methods cannot be independently credited from one answer.
Four divisibility questions ask recognition of valid reasoning, not independent written proof. Four numeric outputs do not reveal whether a factorization shortcut was actually used.
No historical learner statistics are migrated or reinterpreted; four answer-text fixes have a different question content version despite retaining the same legacy ID.
Overlays are review-only; do not automatically convert null primary into a new skill.
No independent external Gemini review is claimed.
